messages:
Lina (Onboarding Ops): Quick question — I sent the orientation calendar invite for next Tuesday but a couple of folks reported the time showing weirdly in their calendars. Also some clients' calendar apps aren't showing the Zoom link/passcode. Can folks advise best fix? cc @devex-bot

devex-bot: Orientation invite created by Lina. ICS attached to original event. Recording will be saved to our Onboarding Box folder.

Arjun Patel: I got the invite and it shows the start at 03:00 on my Google Calendar (I'm in SG, UTC+8). The timezone header says PST though.

Lina (Onboarding Ops): ugh — sounds like the invite was created from my machine set to PST. Should we recreate the invite in UTC or include explicit local times in the description?

Jules Meyer: Recreate is safer. Two tips: 1) set the event timezone to UTC (some calendar clients map better), 2) include a tiny table in the description with conversions for common zones (PST / CET / SGT / AEST). Also put the Zoom join link AND the passcode in the description so Outlook/Apple clients can pick it up.

Kira Novak: For EU folks the recording access is a question — can we also pin the recording to Notion onboarding page after the session? Some of our new hires can't access Box without extra perms.

Arjun Patel: Another thing — my Outlook desktop client didn't accept the ICS because the file lacked an X-ALT-DESC or timezone block. If you recreate from Google Calendar, export the ICS and double-check it includes TZID blocks, or create separate "Add to calendar" links per zone.

Lina (Onboarding Ops): Plan: I'll recreate the event in UTC, add an inline conversion table (small), paste the Zoom URL + passcode in the description, attach a fresh ICS exported from Google Calendar, and post the Notion recording link after the session. I'll also mark the event as "Busy" so it blocks calendars.

devex-bot: Tip: Quick command to generate an ICS with explicit TZ: `gcalcli add --when "2026-10-05 18:00" --duration 60 --description "Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx Passcode: 123456" --title "Redwood Orientation" --calendar "Onboarding"` — then export. Or via GCAL UI: More actions -> Publish event -> Add to calendar links.

Jules Meyer: Also add a tiny troubleshooting blurb in the description: "If your calendar shows the wrong time, check your OS timezone and the event timezone. If it's still wrong, DM Lina and we'll send an ICS for your zone."

Kira Novak: Can you include an "If you're in APAC" callout? We had a new hire join at 2am local once because of a mismatch. :grimacing:

Lina (Onboarding Ops): will do. I'll update by EOD and post the new invite link + the Notion page where the recording will live. If anyone notices any other quirks on export (Outlook/Apple), please reply here with a short note.

Arjun Patel: :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Orientation invite updated: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=updated-invite-id — ICS attached. Recording link will be posted in #new-hires and Notion after session.
